# vendor/lib/

The four TUTK/Kalay shared libraries the bridge loads (SDK **4.3.6.x**, Kalay 2.0 / DTLS-PSK).
Extract them from the ROLA APK (`lib/armeabi-v7a/`) on a device you own — see
[../../docs/SETUP.md](../../docs/SETUP.md). They are **not** redistributed here.

```
libTUTKGlobalAPIs.so
libIOTCAPIs.so
libRDTAPIs.so
libAVAPIs.so
```
